title: Luceras Head
heading: Luceras: the head
lede: Stage 5 of 11, part 1 of 5. The head sculpted onto the approved blockout: skull, muzzle, eyes, horns, ears, placeholder whiskers. Judge shape only: does it read as the model sheet's head? Surface detail, horn ridge waviness, the crisp lid line and real whiskers belong to the surface stage. Approve, or say what needs work and in which view. Confirm notifies the orchestrator.
fallback: Approvals cannot be saved from this view; reply in chat.
compositeEmpty: Confirm closes the head; the torso part starts next.
confirmed: Head confirmed; the orchestrator files it and starts the next part. Tell the orchestrator you confirmed.

fold.title: Decided by the pipeline owner
fold.text: Both streams were given the same brief twice: first with Blender work only (hand-placed masses), which stalled on the face in both streams, then, after a hold audit, with the face reconstructed from your clay head views and the authored horns, eyes and ears re-seated. That audit result is now a pipeline rule: faces and other soft forms come from reconstruction. The Claude head took four passes: masses (rodent), measured fixes (balloon), reconstruction graft (reads), cleanup. The Codex stream's reconstruction pass is being finished and will be added here for comparison; its masses pass is shown below. Everything outside the head is unchanged to within 0.6 mm. Costs: Claude about 2 hours 20 minutes wall and about 490K tokens over four passes; Codex pass 2 about 80 minutes wall.

claude.name: Claude stream head (pass 4)
claude.question: Does this head read as the model sheet's head?
judge: Three-quarter: brow, cheekbone, nose bridge, short muzzle as the sheet?
Horns: large, slim, ridged, half-turn, tips turned in, sitting on the skull?
Ears: small, rounded, cupped, behind the horn bases?
Eyes: large, forward, high, seated with lids?
claude.note: Declared leftovers for later stages: two faint nubs per whisker pad at the close side camera, ring-like horn ridges, a soft lid line, placeholder whiskers.
